definitions.gloss: cram school; tutoring school; after-school study school
definitions.explanation: A private supplementary school where students attend after regular school hours to prepare for entrance exams or improve academic performance. A central part of the Japanese education system.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{学習塾|がくしゅうじゅく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}わせている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I'm sending my child to a cram school.

examples.japanese: {学習塾|がくしゅうじゅく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月謝|げっしゃ}→月謝：16421_gessha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{結構|けっこう}→結構：10387_kekkou⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: The monthly tuition for cram school is quite expensive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中学|ちゅうがく}→中学：03477_chuugaku⟧⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{小学|しょうがく}→小学：29351_shougaku⟧4⟦{年生|ねんせい}→年生：30431_nensei⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{学習塾|がくしゅうじゅく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}い→通う：01217_kayou⟧{始|はじ}める{子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many children start attending cram school from the fourth grade of elementary school in preparation for middle school entrance exams.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧ (study, learning) + ⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧ (private school). This is the formal term for cram schools; in everyday conversation, people often say simply ⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学習塾|がくしゅうじゅく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to attend a cram school
- {学習塾|がくしゅうじゅく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{講師|こうし}→講師：00451_koushi⟧: cram school instructor
- {学習塾|がくしゅうじゅく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月謝|げっしゃ}→月謝：16421_gessha⟧: cram school monthly tuition
- ⟦{個別|こべつ}{指導|しどう}→個別指導：17360_kobetsushidou⟧⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧: individual tutoring school

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧: cram school — shorter, more casual version of the same concept
- ⟦{予備校|よびこう}→予備校：04785_yobikou⟧: prep school — specifically for university entrance exam preparation, typically for high school students
- {進学塾|しんがくじゅく}: advancement-oriented cram school — focused specifically on entrance exam preparation

CULTURAL NOTE:
Cram schools are a major part of Japanese education culture. According to surveys, over half of Japanese middle school students attend some form of ⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧. The industry is large, with major chains like {河合塾|かわいじゅく} and {日能研|にちのうけん} being household names.
